scope: Installed Quarto source investigation and generated-report dependency review; parent performs browser console/visual QA.

cause.details: extractJupyterWidgetDependencies classifies any display_data or execute_result containing text/html or application/javascript as jsWidgets. includesForJupyterWidgetDependencies consequently adds CDN RequireJS 2.3.6, CDN jQuery 3.5.1 and a named jquery define call even when the HTML consists only of static tables, metric cards and figure markup.
cause.note: The viewer uses a local Plotly script in a separate iframe and does not need a report-page AMD loader. The specific UMD library responsible for the reported anonymous definition was not independently identified; removing the unnecessary AMD environment eliminates this conflict path.

resolution.change: Use IPython.display.Markdown for the same static HTML strings instead of IPython.display.HTML in the three shared helpers.
resolution.expected_effect: Jupyter MIME output changes from text/html to text/markdown; Pandoc preserves the embedded static HTML, and Quarto no longer injects the widget dependencies.

status: Fixed and verified on rebuilt index; remaining pages await final full-site rebuild.

compiled_index_checks.table_DOM_difference: The Markdown MIME route retains the original table classes, hierarchy, headers and cells. Quarto no longer adds caption-top, header/odd/even row classes or data-quarto-table-cell-role attributes; those generated attributes do not change data or the observed Bootstrap-striped table layout.
compiled_index_checks.qualification: The index uses metric_cards and show_table, plus a Markdown overview image. The shared figure helper MIME change is present in source; figure-containing pages require the final full-site rebuild and QA.

parent_browser_verification.performed_by: Parent agent using actual Chrome CUA; reported to this independent source-review agent
parent_browser_verification.visual_result: Overview cards and layout intact in actual screenshot
parent_browser_verification.qualification: Previously retained console errors predate the fix; other QMD pages await the final full-site rebuild.

final_full_site_verification.details: Historical errors predate the fix. Full-site links/dependency checks are recorded in compiled_report_checks.json; actual browser scope and screenshot in browser_checks.json.
